correctness.rationale: For each peripheral clique, every majority-stable set uses at most floor(s_i/2)+1 vertices from the clique together with the hub. Summation of fractional coverage constraints yields every lower bound (s_i+1)/(floor(s_i/2)+1). Two explicit majority-stable distributions with masses 1 and L-1 achieve all vertex cover constraints, since L b_i >=s_i+1 and hub selections respect its total outdegree. This exact proof applies to all t>=1 and s_i>=1. Separate graph-level LP computations agree for 230 small ordered profiles.

value.rationale: This is a complete, natural exact invariant for all unequal one-hub clique bouquets under the newly studied fractional-majority relaxation. The parameter exhibits a sharp odd-block parity jump and is governed by the single largest even peripheral clique otherwise, although the hub degree and feasible majority-stable sets change whenever further cliques are attached. Matching constructive optimal fractional weight distributions provide a structural result, not a table recomputation or a relabeled general upper bound.
